user.title: Add a Xiaomi Miot BLE device
user.description: Select a supported nearby device. Home Assistant will prepare local Bluetooth access automatically.

cloud_auth.title: Connect your Xiaomi account
cloud_auth.description: Sign in to prepare local Bluetooth access for {name}. The password is used only during setup and is not stored. The resulting Xiaomi Cloud session is stored locally so it can be reused for other devices.

cloud_account.title: Choose a Xiaomi account
cloud_account.description: Use a saved Xiaomi Cloud session for {name}, or add another Xiaomi account.

cloud_captcha.title: Complete Xiaomi Cloud captcha
cloud_captcha.description:
Enter the text shown below to continue setting up {name}.

![Xiaomi captcha]({captcha_image})

cloud_verify.title: Complete Xiaomi account verification
cloud_verify.description: [Open the Xiaomi verification page]({verification_url}) and request a phone or email verification code. Do not submit the code on the Xiaomi page. Return here and enter the code below to continue setting up {name}.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected the local access key
error.cloud_invalid_account: Xiaomi rejected the account identifier (error 20003/70002). Try the Xiaomi ID, email address, or full phone number used by Xiaomi Home
error.cloud_verification_required: Xiaomi requires additional account verification (error 81003). Complete the security check in Xiaomi Home or the Xiaomi account website, then try again
error.cloud_session_error: Account sign-in succeeded, but Xiaomi did not create a usable cloud session
error.cloud_session_storage_error: The Xiaomi Cloud session could not be saved locally
error.cloud_saved_session_missing: The selected saved Xiaomi account no longer exists
error.cloud_saved_session_expired: Xiaomi rejected the saved account session. It was removed; sign in again or choose another account
error.cloud_invalid_captcha: Xiaomi Cloud rejected the captcha; try the refreshed image
error.cloud_invalid_verification: Xiaomi Cloud rejected the verification code
error.cloud_device_not_found: The Bluetooth device was not found in this Xiaomi account
error.cloud_token_unavailable: Xiaomi Cloud did not return the 12-byte Standard Auth token required for local control
error.cloud_key_unsupported: Xiaomi Cloud returned an invalid Standard Auth token

abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not supported
abort.no_supported_devices: No supported nearby Bluetooth devices were found
abort.missing_setup_data: Device setup information expired; start the flow again
abort.missing_cloud_challenge: Xiaomi Cloud verification expired; start the flow again
